category_edits.rationale: Learn one positive embedding gain per category model, initialized to 1 and bounded within [0.5, 4]. Apply it to the tied normalized history, target and candidate embeddings while preserving zero padding. The generated predictor imports the updated model class and restores the gain from its single checkpoint.

response.change_summary: Add a jointly learned bounded scalar gain to the tied unit-normalized item embeddings across all four category models. Preserve the GRU, scoring formula, loss, optimizer and training settings; existing predictor loading restores the new parameter.
